title: satk.sigproc.mmfilt~
description: `satk.sigproc.mmfilt~` is a multimode audio filter that can operate as a low-pass, high-pass, or band-pass filter, allowing selected portions of a signal’s spectrum to pass. Filter type is selected with values 0, 1, or 2, while cutoff frequency, band-pass Q/bandwidth, and dry/wet balance are adjustable; a dry/wet value of 0 outputs the original signal and 1 outputs only the filtered signal.
